mapper.select: SELECT fa.financial_account_id, fa.child_id, fa.account_product_type, fa.account_status, fa.link_status, fa.maturity_date FROM financial_account fa INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = fa.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId}
